Speaking Skills: Working on fluency, pronunciation, intonation, and accent reduction.
Listening and Reading Comprehension: Teaching strategies for improving understanding, speed, and accuracy.
Exam Preparation: In-depth coaching for standardized tests.
My teaching methods are;
1. Communicative Language Teaching (CLT): I prioritize real-life communication, encouraging students to practice English in context through conversations, role-plays, and debates.
2. Task-Based Learning (TBL): Lessons are built around tasks that simulate real-world situations, allowing students to apply language in practical scenarios.
3. Grammar and Vocabulary in Context: Instead of focusing on isolated grammar drills, I introduce grammar and vocabulary within meaningful contexts to enhance retention and practical use.
4. Flipped Classroom Approach: I often provide learning materials for students to explore at home (like videos or articles), then use class time to practice and discuss the content, making our lessons more interactive.
5. Technology Integration: I incorporate digital tools, such as language apps, interactive quizzes, and online platforms, to make learning more dynamic and accessible.
6. Pronunciation and Accent Reduction: I focus on clear communication, helping students reduce their accent or improve their pronunciation based on their specific needs.
